jobs.description:
KCB is a multidisciplinary engineering, geoscience, and environmental consulting firm grounded in our values of Passion, Integrity, and Excellence. With teams across North America, South America, Australasia, and Europe, we bring together global technical knowledge, local insight, and a shared commitment to solving complex challenges that matter.

Guided by our long-term ambition of Globally Connected Excellence and our purpose of Sustaining the Future, we work alongside our clients to deliver lasting solutions that strengthen resilience and benefit future generations.

Who We're Looking For

We're growing our Brisbane Geotechnical Engineering team and are seeking a Senior Geotechnical Engineer to help deliver technically complex projects across tailings and mine waste storage facilities, water management structures, dams, and mining infrastructure.

In this role, you'll leverage your technical expertise, leadership capability, and relationship-building skills to lead the delivery of significant tailings, dam, mine waste, and geotechnical projects across Australia and internationally. You'll also play a key role in strengthening existing client relationships, developing new business opportunities, and expanding KCB's presence throughout the region.

We're looking for a respected consulting engineer with a strong technical reputation and a proven ability to help clients solve complex engineering challenges. The successful candidate will be comfortable leading multidisciplinary teams, engaging directly with clients, providing technical oversight and mentorship, and contributing to strategic project and business development initiatives.

This opportunity is ideal for someone who is motivated by technical excellence, values long-term client partnerships, and is excited by the opportunity to help shape the continued growth and success of KCB's Australian business.

What You'll do

As a Senior Geotechnical Engineer, you will:

- Lead and contribute to the planning, design, assessment, and management of tailings storage facilities, mine waste facilities, water storage dams, and associated earthworks infrastructure.

- Provide senior technical leadership and review for complex geotechnical, tailings, and dam engineering projects.

- For the right candidate with appropriate experience, fulfill Engineer of Record roles for operational facilities as part of a larger technical project team.

- Undertake and oversee:

- Slope stability assessments

- Seepage and groundwater analyses

- Tailings deposition modelling

- Dam safety and risk assessments

- Closure and rehabilitation planning

- Material characterisation and interpretation of laboratory and field investigation data

- Lead geotechnical investigations, field programs, site inspections, construction monitoring, and QA/QC activities.

- Prepare and review technical reports, design documentation, specifications, proposals, and engineering studies.

- Manage multidisciplinary project teams to deliver projects safely, efficiently, and to a high technical standard.

- Provide project management leadership including planning, budgeting, scheduling, resource coordination, and contract management.

- Develop and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective clients.

- Identify, pursue, and help secure new business opportunities across the mining, resources, and water sectors.

- Lead or contribute to proposals, tenders, and contract negotiations.

- Mentor and coach graduate, junior, and intermediate engineers, supporting their professional development and technical growth.

- Promote technical excellence, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement across the business.

- Work in accordance with KCB's Quality Management System and Health & Safety requirements.

- Collaborate with teams across Australia and KCB's global network.

What You'll Bring

We are seeking a highly capable engineer with a strong track record in project delivery, client engagement, and leadership.

To be successful in this role, you will have:

- Degree in Civil Engineering (Geotechnical) or equivalent engineering qualification.

- Approximately 15+ years' experience in geotechnical, tailings, dam, mine waste, or related engineering disciplines.

- Proven experience delivering tailings, dam, and geotechnical projects within a consulting or mining environment.

- Demonstrated expertise in one or more of the following:

- Tailings storage facility design and management

- Dam and embankment engineering

- Mine waste management facilities

- Closure and rehabilitation planning

- Geotechnical investigations and construction support

- Strong understanding of relevant industry guidelines and standards including ANCOLD, GISTM, ICOLD, and CDA.

- Experience using geotechnical analysis software such as GeoStudio, SLOPE/W, SEEP/W, Rocscience, PLAXIS, FLAC, GoldSim, Muk3D, or similar packages.

- Excellent technical report writing, review, and communication skills.

- Demonstrated experience leading projects and multidisciplinary teams.

- A proven ability to develop and maintain strong client relationships.

- Experience preparing proposals, developing scopes of work, and contributing to business development activities.

- A genuine interest in mentoring and developing less experienced engineers.

- Chartered status (CPEng, RPEQ, NER or equivalent), or eligibility to obtain registration, will be highly regarded.

What We Offer

At KCB, you'll enjoy the opportunities of a global consultancy while remaining connected to a supportive and accessible local team. You'll work alongside recognised industry leaders on some of the mining sector's most technically challenging and rewarding projects.

In addition, we offer:

- Additional Superannuation: 2.5% extra to help secure your future.

- Income Protection Insurance: Peace of mind for you and your family.

- Parental and Volunteer Leave: Support for your personal and community commitments.

- Purchase Leave: Up to 15 additional annual leave days per year.

- Novated Leasing: Flexible vehicle leasing options.

- Hybrid Working Arrangements: Greater flexibility in how you work.

- Wellbeing Programs: Initiatives that support your social, mental, and physical wellbeing.

- Learning and Development Opportunities: Ongoing professional growth and career development.

- Performance Incentives: Additional incentives may be available based on company, business unit, and individual performance.

Ready to Apply?

If you're looking to apply your design expertise to some of the mining industry's most complex and rewarding tailings and mine waste projects, we'd love to hear from you.

About Us

Klohn Crippen Berger (KCB) is a multidisciplinary consulting firm providing engineering, geoscience, and environmental services globally. With offices across Australia, Canada, the USA, the UK, Brazil, and Peru, we deliver practical solutions to complex challenges in mining, water resources, power, transportation, and the environment.

We respect the uniqueness that makes you, you. We are committed to employment equity and encourage applications from all qualified candidates. KCB is proud to be an Australian Business Awards Employer of Choice recipient (2015-2025).

jobs.description:
SENIOR GEOTECHNICAL ENGINEER – Lead ground control at Australia's most exciting emerging gold-antimony project

5:2 Roster | Full-time, Permanent | Sunday Creek, VIC (residential) Underground Development

SXGC is exploring the most exciting new gold and antimony discovery in Australia, with our flagship Sunday Creek project moving from surface exploration towards future underground mining. As the operation grows, strong ground control will keep our people and workings safe while supporting efficient underground development and stoping, so we're looking for a Senior Geotechnical Engineer to lead that function and build the team behind it.

Why SXGC?

Because your work here matters.

You'll join a growing ASX and TSX-listed explorer at a pivotal stage, leading geotechnical engineering as Sunday Creek moves from exploration towards development. Here your work matters on the ground: you'll set the ground control standards, systems and team that underground mining at Sunday Creek will rely on, working closely with the mining, development and projects teams.

About the Role

Reporting to the Underground Development Manager, you will lead geotechnical engineering at Sunday Creek to keep people and workings safe from ground-related hazards while supporting efficient underground development and stoping. You'll own the Ground Control Management Plan, ground support design and standards, geotechnical monitoring and data, and excavation and stope design input. You'll lead Geotechnical Engineers and Technicians, manage geotechnical consultants and ground support contractors, and provide geotechnical leadership to the mining, development and projects teams, with input to studies as the operation grows.

What You’ll Drive

Lead and develop the geotechnical team, including Geotechnical Engineers and Technicians, building a strong ground-awareness and safety culture across site

Own and maintain the Ground Control Management Plan and the ground-related principal mining hazard controls under the site Safety Management System

Design ground support for development, stoping and infrastructure excavations, and set and maintain ground support standards and Trigger Action Response Plans (TARPs)

Provide geotechnical input to mine design, including stope dimensions, pillar design, sequencing, backfill requirements and excavation stability, using numerical and empirical methods

Manage geotechnical data collection, rock mass characterisation and core logging, and maintain the site geotechnical model and database

Plan and run geotechnical monitoring, including ground support quality control (pull and shotcrete testing), deformation and seismic monitoring, and routine underground inspections and mapping

Investigate ground-related incidents and falls of ground, leading root cause analysis and continuous improvement in ground control practice

Provide geotechnical input to technical studies, mine planning and life-of-mine design, including surface infrastructure, portals, ventilation raises and dewatering excavations

Manage geotechnical consultants, ground support contractors and the geotechnical budget, including scope, quality and invoice review

Train and coach mining, development and supervisory crews in ground awareness, scaling and ground support installation, and ensure compliance with the Victorian OHS (Mines) Regulations and Earth Resources obligations, including reporting to management and the regulator

Who You Are

You're an experienced underground geotechnical engineer ready to lead. You care about keeping people and workings safe from ground-related hazards and you turn technical analysis into practical standards that crews will follow. You communicate clearly with mining, development and projects teams, you influence operational crews and you enjoy building a function in a growing operation.

Your Background

Tertiary degree in Geotechnical, Mining or Civil Engineering, or Engineering Geology; a postgraduate qualification in geomechanics is highly regarded

At least eight years' geotechnical experience in underground hard rock mining

Strong working knowledge of rock mass characterisation, ground support design, stope and pillar design, and mine-induced seismicity

Proven experience writing and implementing a Ground Control Management Plan and TARPs on an operating mine

Proficiency with geotechnical software such as Rocscience (RS2, Unwedge, Dips), Map3D, FLAC or similar, and with Deswik or equivalent mine design packages

Demonstrated experience managing consultants and contractors, including scope, quality and invoice control, and managing a budget

Strong leadership and communication skills, with the ability to influence operational crews and build a team in a growing operation

Desirable: experience in a senior or lead site role, Chartered Professional Engineer (CPEng) or RPEQ status, and experience with narrow-vein or steeply dipping orebodies

The Practical Details

Location: Sunday Creek, VIC (residential)

Roster: 5:2

Contract: Full-time, Permanent

Reports to: Underground Development Manager

Required checks

- Relevant medical and background checks

- Valid driver’s licence

- Right to work & qualifications verification

Ready to Lead Ground Control at Sunday Creek?

If you're ready to lead geotechnical engineering at Sunday Creek we'd love to hear from you. Apply now to join the SXGC team.

About Southern Cross Gold Consolidated Ltd

Southern Cross Gold Consolidated Ltd (SXGC) is listed on the Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX) and has CHESS Depositary Interests (CDIs) listed on the Australian Securities Exchange (ASX).

We explore for gold and antimony in the Victorian Goldfields. Our 100% owned flagship project at Sunday Creek is the best new grassroots discovery in Australia with a globally leading high-grade hit rate for this stage of the project’s development.

Our results demonstrate high-grades and wide zones of gold and antimony over a 12km mineralised trend. As at 10th June, 2026, we have delivered 88 intersections exceeding 100 g/t Au from just 124km of drilling at Sunday Creek including results such as 1.0 m @ 2,318 g/t Au drilled within 455.3 m @ 7.2 g/t Au and 13.1 m @ 91.7 g/t Au within 331.5 m @ 6.8 g/t Au.

Our corporate objectives are to discover and develop large, long-life, sustainable assets which create value for shareholders and all stakeholders in the community.
